headline: 1948 educational film breaks down an *eight-dollar* weekly *income*
quote: There's that work-at-home allowance of $2 a week. And Jack earns $6 a week working part-time in the library.
title: 1948 educational film: How did teens budget an eight-dollar weekly income?
caption: A 1948 educational film breaks down a teenager's weekly earnings from home chores and a library job.
comment: Could you cover your weekly expenses on eight dollars today?
